description: Score a sequence against a fixed backbone with the official ESM-IF1 inverse-folding model.

atom_dim.title: 原子维度
atom_dim.description: Dim name of the structure form's atom axis.

field_dim.title: 字段维度
field_dim.description: Dim name of the structure form's field axis.

residue_dim.title: 残基维度
residue_dim.description: Dim name assigned to the scored residues on the output form.

chain.title: 打分链
chain.description: Chain whose backbone conditions the sequence probabilities.

model_path.title: ESM-IF 权重路径
model_path.description: Local ESM-IF1 checkpoint such as esm_if1_gvp4_t16_142M_UR50.pt. No weights are downloaded automatically.

sequence.title: 待打分序列
sequence.description: One-letter sequence to score. Leave empty to score the sequence read from the structure.

output.title: 输出名称
output.description: Form name registered in the execution context.
